chapter.verse: Mi siangthote ading sumpi khiatna thu ahih leh, Galati gam pawlpite ka vaikhak mah bangin na hih un.
Ka hong tun’ ciangin kaihkhop tawm a kul nawn loh nadingin nisagih laka ni masa bel ni-in mi a vekpi in na ngah bangun na khia khol ciat un.
Ka hong tun’ ciangin mi na deihte uh laitai sakin na piak uh sumpi Jerusalem khua ah puak dingin ka sawl ding hi.
Kei zong ka pai theih leh, amau in keimah tawh a paikhawm ding uh hi.
Makedonia gam lam ka pai khit ciangin note kiangah ka hong tung ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Makedonia gam lam ka tawn ding hi.
Tua nung ciangin mundang ah ka pai ciangin, note hong khak, thupha ka ngah nadingin, note kiangah phalbi tawntung ka om kha ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lam lai-ah kimuh ding bek ka ut kei hi. Topa in thu hong piak leh, sauveipi note tawh omkhawm dingin ka lamen hi.
Pentekost pawikham ni dongin Efesa khua ah ka om ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lawhcin’ nadingin alian kongkhak a mansa-in kei ading a kihong hi. Hong langpan mi zong tampi a om uh hi.
Timoti in note kiangah hong tun’ leh, amah lungmang loin note tawh a omkhawm theih nadingin na kiging un. Amah in zong keimah bangin Pasian’ nasem ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah kuamah simmawhsak kei un. Ka kiangah hong paikik nadingin lungman’na om lo dingin hong kha un. Amah in ute naute tawh hong tonkhawm ding hi ci-in lawpin ka om hi.
I sanggampa Apollos thu panin, ute naute tawh note kiangah hong pai dingin ka zol hangin amah in tu-in pai ding ut nai lo hi. A nung ciangin ahih theih leh, a hong pai ding hi.
Note in kikemin ngak un. Upna ah na kip un. Pasal tawh kibangin thacingin, thahat un.
Itna lungsim tawh na khempeuh na hih un.
Ute naute aw, Stefanas-te’ innkuan in Akhaia gamah a gah masabel ahi uh a, misiangthote’ nasem dingin amau pumpi uh hong piak uh mah bangin,
tua bang mite’ ukna ahi zongin, nasepna ah a hahkat mi khempeuh a ukna uh ahi zongin na man’ nadingun ka hong thuum hi.
Stefanas, Fortunatas leh Akhaikas-te hong tung ahih ciangin ka lung a dam hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in na hong bawl uh a kicing lote amaute in a hong kicingsak kik uh a,
ka lungsim leh note lungsim uh hong tawldam sak zo uh hi. Tua bang mite na ciamteh un.
Asia gama pawlpite in note hong hopih uh hi. Akuila leh Prisilla in, amau innah a om pawlpite tawh, Topa suangin note tampi-in hong hopih uh hi.
Ute naute khempeuh in note hong hopih uh hi. Khat leh khat a siangtho napna tawh na kihopih ciat un.
Keimah Paul in kihopih nading ka khut tawh kong gelh hi.
Mi khat peuhmah in Topa a it kei leh, tua mi in hamsiatna thuak ta hen. Topa hong pai hi!
Topa Zeisu’ hehpihna thupha note tungah om ta hen.
Ka itna in Khazih Zeisu sunga om note khempeuh tawh omkhawm ta hen. Amen.
